integrity: The claim is proved symbolically from the transformed equation, homogeneity, and periodic-adjoint Floquet duality. No numerical computation is used as proof. Earlier numerical and computer-assisted spectra are used only for comparison.
scientific_limitations: Conditional on existence of a nonconstant periodic solution of the auxiliary equation; existence for every q>1, uniqueness, basin geometry, and robustness under general lower-order perturbations are not proved.
title: Conditional exact Floquet spectrum for fourth-order blow-up profiles
